question: Where is the headquarters of the National Turmeric Board, which was established in 2025?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Nizamabad**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The headquarters of the **National Turmeric Board**, established in **2025**, is located in **Nizamabad**.
 
• **Nizamabad** is a city in the state of **Telangana**, India, and is well-known for its turmeric production.
 
• The region is often referred to as the "**Turmeric City**" due to its significant contribution to the cultivation and trade of turmeric.
 
• The establishment of the **National Turmeric Board** aims to promote the turmeric industry, encourage better farming practices, and enhance the global market presence of Indian turmeric.
 
• Nizamabad has a strategic advantage due to its proximity to turmeric-growing regions and its established trade links for exporting turmeric products.
 
• The board is expected to work on enhancing **research and development** for turmeric, improving farmer incomes, and ensuring sustainable farming practices.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Kochi**__

 __
 
• **Kochi**, located in the state of Kerala, is known as the "**Queen of the Arabian Sea**." It is a major port city and a hub for the spice trade in India.
 
• While Kochi plays a significant role in the spice industry, it is not specifically associated with turmeric production.
 
 
 
• **Guntur**__
 __
 
• **Guntur** is located in the state of Andhra Pradesh and is famous for the production of **chili peppers**.
 
• Although it is an important agricultural region, it is more associated with chili production than turmeric.
 
 
 
• **Kolkata**__
 
 
• **Kolkata**, the capital of West Bengal, is known for its **cultural heritage** and as a major economic and trade center in eastern India.
 
• It does not have a direct or major role in turmeric production or trade.
